Gratitude, not merely for having once loved her, but for loving her still well enough, to forgive all the petulance…” slowly and put it in my own words: Lying awake, Elizabeth decides she feels gratitude to Darcy for still loving her well enough to forgive her harsh rejection. My answer: The new feeling Elizabeth finds for Darcy is gratitude, warmth and respect in place of dislike; Austen shows love growing from understanding his generosity rather than from attraction alone.
